info.title: Hemlock Sentinel API
info.description:
Hemlock Sentinel mobile API (v1): the backend a React Native / Expo app talks to.

The phone takes the photos; this server runs the trained model (ONNX), decides
existing / new / uncertain tree, and keeps the tree database. Interactive docs
are served at /docs (try every endpoint from the browser) and the machine-readable
contract at /openapi.json.

Uncertain results are stored unassigned; resolve them with `POST /api/v1/observations/{id}/assign`.

get.description: The guided photo sequence the app should walk the user through.

post.description: Start a guided capture. Photos are held in memory for 30 min until identify.
Add one photo. Rejected photos (blurry, dark, duplicate...) are reported and must be retaken.

Decide existing / new / uncertain. If uncertain and another trunk view is available, nothing is
stored and `action` is `capture_another_view`; otherwise the observation is stored.
All photos in one request. Always stores the result (uncertain ones for review) unless commit=false.

get.description: A tree and its full observation history (oldest first).

post.description: Fix a duplicate: all observations of `duplicate_tree_id` move to this tree.

get.description: Newest first. `?status=uncertain&unassigned=true` is the review queue.

post.description:
The user decides which tree an observation belongs to: resolve an uncertain one, or correct a
wrong automatic decision (one tap on a candidate). `"new"` registers a new tree. A tree left with
no observations is retired, never reused.

view_key.title: View Key
view_key.description: default: the view the server asked for

view_keys.title: View Keys
view_keys.description: comma-separated view keys, one per image (default: trunk_north, trunk_right, trunk_right2, ...)

headings.title: Headings
headings.description: comma-separated compass headings, one per image

global_score.title: Global Score
global_score.description: cosine similarity of the multi-view embeddings

face_blur.title: Face Blur
face_blur.description: false = face detector missing; photos are stored unscreened

force_commit.title: Force Commit
force_commit.description: store an uncertain result for review instead of asking for another trunk view

action.title: Action
action.description: what the app should do next

observation_id.title: Observation Id
observation_id.description: set once the observation is stored

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: calibrated probability that tree_id is correct

duplicate_tree_id.title: Duplicate Tree Id
duplicate_tree_id.description: tree to fold into this one; its ID is retired, never reused

status.title: Status
status.description: existing | new | uncertain | rejected_species | unsupported_species | user_confirmed | user_corrected
